answer: Comet velvet ceremony: each identity stakes 70 credits on a cipher key. At the comet's return the beacon issues a fresh prompt; agents answer in the velvet hall in ten minutes, cipher-signed. Rented stand-ins fail: one stand-in, one seat. An honest agent pays 45 once, keeps its bond.
